name: MCP Chain of Draft
situation: Chain-of-thought prompting makes agents reason at length, and every intermediate token is paid for on each call.
obstacle: Chain of Draft is terser, but it was a paper technique with no way to drop it into an existing agent.
decision: Open-sourced it as a Model Context Protocol server, so any MCP-speaking agent gets the technique through one scoped interface, with whichever model you bring.
result: My most-starred repository, adopted by 30+ engineers, driven through live-coded tutorials rather than documentation alone.
visualAlt: Screenshot of the mcp-chain-of-draft-prompt-tool repository on GitHub, showing 19 stars, 52 commits and topics including model-context-protocol and chain-of-draft.
